useCase.name: Register Customer and Capture Client Information
useCase.description: Customer registers on the web portal or mobile app and provides client-specific information such as NIN, passport number, TIN, business license, and work permit.

useCase.name: Initiate Service Request
useCase.description: Registered customer creates a new service request for an advertising campaign or program.

useCase.name: Review Request and Determine Payment Terms
useCase.description: Sales Officer receives the request, identifies payment mode, checks discount support, and consults production team when necessary.

useCase.name: Route Approval for Post-Payment Request
useCase.description: System retrieves the credit limit and routes approval based on the amount thresholds for post-payment requests.

useCase.name: Route Approval for Pre-Payment Request
useCase.description: For pre-payment requests, the system notifies SM for no-discount requests and routes approved discount cases to DSM or DG based on discount percentage.

useCase.name: Prepare and Submit Draft Contract
useCase.description: Sales Officer prepares the draft contract and submits it to SM for verification and decision.

useCase.name: Contract Review and Legal Vetting
useCase.description: DSM reviews the contract, DLS manages legal review, and AG provides advice for contracts of TZS 1 billion or more.

useCase.name: Final Contract Signature and Customer Presentation
useCase.description: DG signs the contract, DSM executes it, and the Sales Officer presents it to the customer for signing.

useCase.name: Generate Pro Forma Invoice
useCase.description: Sales Officer generates a pro forma invoice for post-payment or pre-payment requests and sends it to the relevant party.

useCase.name: Capture Production Metadata and Submit for Production
useCase.description: Sales Officer captures metadata, attaches required documents, and submits the production task to DTVS/DRA and Producer.

useCase.name: Customer Review and Final Acceptance
useCase.description: DSM notifies customer of production completion. Customer reviews the production and either returns it for correction or accepts it.

useCase.name: Resolve Schedule Conflict and Effect Media List
useCase.description: System checks schedule conflicts with PRO, notifies HLU/Radio Producer, and updates the media list or AVRA accordingly.
